scope: Fresh matched-state validation of all three predeclared H scores; fixed strict-B selector and bounded mixed5 discovery; no PPO fitting or automatic winner
selector: Frozen strict B, maximum supported proxy risk, time/actor-ID ties
later_actions: Unchanged natural NDE; only initial decision is tilted

confirmation.rule: Uniform sample within common strict-B eligible sources, saved before outcomes; each physical case measured once for all proposals; no replacement

fixed_budget: 256 previously unopened natural sources; at most five states and three pair audits/state; at most one common strict-B case/source. Each proposal has the same 64 continuations/case. No event-dependent extension, substitution, fitting or restart with only positive cases.
uncertainty: Same conditional state law across H proposals; whole-source paired bootstrap, distinct-source guards and fixed-state stratified MCSE; no original-initialization acceleration
